definition.text: Watch-post, an ancient city of the Canaanites; with its villages, allotted to Zebulun (Josh. 19:15); now probably Semunieh, on the northern edge of the plain of Esdraelon, 5 miles west of Nazareth.

lemmas.gloss: Shimron, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
